description: This file defines a utility class 'TemporalExpressionWorker' for managing persistence and creation of 'TemporalExpression' objects in the 'ofbiz' framework. It includes methods to retrieve, construct, and manage different types of temporal expressions from the database, handling recursive relationships and various expression types.

classes.name: TemporalExpressionWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for retrieving and constructing TemporalExpression objects from persistent storage.

methods.name: getTemporalExpression
methods.description: Retrieves a TemporalExpression object from the database based on a given expression ID, with verbose debugging.

methods.name: makeTemporalExpression
methods.description: Constructs a TemporalExpression object from a GenericValue, handling different expression types, including recursive composition.

methods.name: getChildExpressions
methods.description: Fetches child TemporalExpressions for composite expression types like INTERSECTION or UNION.

methods.name: setExpressionId
methods.description: Assigns an ID to a TemporalExpression object based on a GenericValue.

methods.name: getExpressionTypeList
methods.description: Returns a list of all supported TemporalExpression types.
